askEagernessDial.title: Ask eagerness
askEagernessDial.body: How readily Owlat stops to ask you a quick question before drafting. High-stakes slots (money, commitments, dates, tone) always lean cautious; routine acknowledgements are never asked about.

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.hint: Asks more — checks every unclear reply

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.hint: Asks on genuinely open, important slots

off.label: Off
off.hint: Never asks — always drafts for your review

autonomyDemotionAlerts.title: Auto-send paused after a bad outcome
autonomyDemotionAlerts.body: These senders were reverted to draft-only after a confirmed bad auto-send. Review before re-enabling.
autonomyDemotionAlerts.defaultReason: Auto-demoted to draft-only after a bad outcome.

autonomyGraduationNudge.title: Ready to graduate
autonomyGraduationNudge.body: The agent has earned more autonomy. Review the evidence and enable it — nothing widens without your explicit approval.
autonomyGraduationNudge.offer: You approved {matched} of {total} {category} drafts to {sender} unedited — enable auto-send?
autonomyGraduationNudge.suggestion: Lower the {category} auto-approve threshold from {current} to {suggested}?

autonomyKillSwitch.title: Stop auto-sending now
autonomyKillSwitch.body: Instantly revert to {mode}: turns off graduated autonomy and the legacy auto-reply, and pulls back any auto-send still in its undo window. The agent keeps drafting replies for you to review — nothing is dropped.

autonomyLearningControls.strategiesBody: Choose a bundled drafting strategy for each message category. Default uses Owlat's built-in drafter.
autonomyLearningControls.memoryBody: Answers you gave when the agent needed a missing fact. Forget stale answers or carefully widen a contact-specific answer to every sender.
autonomyLearningControls.promotedToast: Learned answer now applies to every sender

autonomyRuleEditor.thresholdHint: Minimum confidence score required for the agent to auto-approve actions in this category.
autonomyRuleEditor.maxDailyHint: Maximum number of actions the agent can auto-approve per day for this category.
autonomyRuleEditor.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the autonomy rule for {category}? This action cannot be undone.

autonomyWorkingHours.title: Working hours
autonomyWorkingHours.subtitle: Only auto-send during business hours.
autonomyWorkingHours.hint: Replies decided outside these hours are held for morning human review — not sent.
